fact: The Ministry of Agriculture announced on 13 August 2026 that the Plant Protection Research Institute renewed ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for the Egyptian Reference Insect Museum for the fourth year, after an audit by a team accredited by EGAC and Accent.
title: «الزراعة» تعلن تجديد اعتماد الأيزو 27001 للمتحف المصري للحشرات
